l6_partial_progress_note: Validated 42-label sequence (sc25 symbolic labels: warmup/cellR,C/clickX,Y/moveN, same grammar as experiment_4468) that, replayed after the banked L5 prefix (warmup + experiment_4468.SC25_PLANS_BY_LEVEL[5]) on a FRESH env, reaches the deepest grounded L6 state achieved so far: 6dd6 box broken, ddd channel-wall dissolved, first energy pickup collected, mini-player at (33-34,17-18) with 30 energy remaining. Replayed twice this session with identical results.
novel_mechanics_found: L6 mechanics substantially decoded (none of this was in the registry): (1) The 9/a 4x4 sprite IS the tank-controlled player (9-half = facing); move1/2/3/4 = up/down/left/right, 4px steps, no separate rotation press needed. (2) The right-edge 'ee' double-column is an ENERGY budget: every label (cast click, cast cell, move) costs ~1 row of 64; energy 0 = GAME_OVER (empty frame). GameAction.RESET recovers from both mid-level and GAME_OVER to a fresh L6 with full energy, levels_completed preserved. (3) The F-spell (cross pattern, panel A) TOGGLES the player between 4x4 and 2x2 mini form - the registry's 'shrink spell'. The mini fits 2px-wide pipes the full player cannot enter. (4) The B-spell (L pattern, panel B) TELEPORTS the player to the currently-lit b-corner pad (three pads: junction (33-36,29-32), SE (37-40,53-56), SW (41-42,13-14)); each cast also advances which pad is lit, and F-casts toggle pad lights too - destination is state-dependent, not positional. (5) THE KEY DISCOVERY: casting a spell while standing ADJACENT to a matching-color box BREAKS the box, dissolves all obstacles elsewhere made of the box's CONTENT color, and spawns a +10 energy pickup in the box's place. Confirmed: 6-spell cast adjacent to the 6dd6 box destroyed it AND removed the 3x4 'ddd' wall blocking the east channel, dropping an energy pickup. By symmetry the 6cc6 box at (37-40,37-40) should remove the cccc shaft barrier (14-16,33-36) that blocks the route to the a-filled reservoir (8-13,32-37) - the presumed exit. (6) Spells cast away from any matching box fizzle (energy spent, no effect).
narrative: Replayed the banked 102-label L5 prefix (307 env steps with animation-resolve presses), then spent the session reverse-engineering L6: identified the player sprite, the energy economy, the shrink toggle, the state-dependent teleport network, and the box-breaking mechanic that dissolves color-linked walls. First run exhausted energy learning these (deliberately, to establish that energy-0 = GAME_OVER and that RESET recovers cleanly). Second run replayed an optimized 42-label line to the deepest state (6dd6 broken + pickup banked, 30 energy in hand) but the remaining env budget (~76 steps) could not cover the projected finish (teleport to the east channel, break 6cc6, return through the cleared shaft to the reservoir; ~80-110 steps). Stopped honestly at the knowledge-maximal state. A fresh session starting from the 42-label line with ~200 free steps should finish L6.
gotchas: Every action label costs ~1 energy row (right-edge ee bar, 64 total); blocked moves into walls sometimes cost 2, no-op moves into background are free. Energy 0 = GAME_OVER on the next action.
GameAction.RESET restores the current level fresh (full energy, levels kept) from both mid-level and GAME_OVER states - same as r11l. Use it freely; env.reset() is NOT needed.
F-spell (cross) toggles player size 4x4 <-> 2x2; the mini moves 2px per step, the full player 4px.
B-spell teleport destination = the currently-LIT b-pad, and lights advance per cast (F-casts also toggle lights); casting B while standing on the lit pad is a no-op that still advances the light.
Casting any spell ADJACENT to a matching-color box breaks it: obstacles of the box's CONTENT color dissolve everywhere, and a +10 energy pickup spawns in the box footprint - walk onto it to collect.
Spell casts away from a matching box fizzle silently (energy wasted). The 6-spell fizzled at the shaft but broke the 6dd6 box when adjacent to it.

The cccc barrier (14-16,33-36) blocks the shaft to the reservoir for BOTH player sizes; hypothesis (untested): breaking the 6cc6 box (37-40,37-40) removes it, mirroring the confirmed dd-box -> ddd-wall link.
The east channel to the 6cc6 box is reachable from the SE pad after the ddd wall is gone (mini: ~6 steps west).
The animation-resolve convention: after each cast label press ACTION5 until the frame is stable (2-10 presses); moves need no resolve. Budget ~3 env steps per cast label, ~1 per move.
The L5 prefix replay costs ~307 env steps with resolves - budget accordingly; a full L6 solve + gate will not fit in one 700-step session unless the prefix cost is amortized.
